name: Ensi RED™ 3 Person Far Infrared Sauna (Top Grade Red Cedar)
description:
ENSI™ INFRARED SAUNA COLLECTION — ZERO-EMF
The new, comfortable, open-style design greatly enhances visibility (and alleviates any fears of claustrophobia) so that everyone can enjoy it. Our LED lighting system is pleasant, without nasty glare, and economical to operate. Combined with our high-quality sound system and digital control panel, the whole experience becomes a matter of pleasant relaxation and ease of operation.

Why go for an infrared sauna with zero-EMF?
Electromagnetic Fields (EMF) are energy waves that people encounter on a daily basis. Most exposure is received from the increased use of electricity and new technologies. Overexposure to EMF poses potential adverse effects on human health. The safest and most effective saunas in the market are those with low- to zero-EMF technology.

How important is it to be Intertek-tested?
Intertek is known as an expert in the certification field that has been around for more than 130 years. Intertek uses only state-of-the-art facilities when inspecting processes and equipment. Intertek certification provides a testament to safety and quality that most consumers trust in buying their in-home sauna, such as 2 Person Infrared Sauna. We at JNH Lifestyles pride ourselves on maintaining the highest standards of sauna safety in the industry.

What can you expect from the Ensi™ Collection?
JNH Lifestyles’ Ensi™ Collection includes all types of infrared saunas for people of all abilities and sizes. Whether you are planning to have an in-home sauna for personal or family use, we have an array of infrared saunas you can choose from.

JNH Lifestyles holds the highest quality safety and sauna certifications. We pride ourselves as the premier manufacturer and supplier of Intertek-tested virtually zero-EMF infrared saunas. Enjoy a zero-EMF infrared sauna in the privacy of your own home.
